weather_report:
The clouds gather subtly over Boston this afternoon, wrapping the city in a drab embrace as a slight chance of rain flirts with the horizon. The air carries a coolness typical of late November, hinting at the fading warmth of autumn. While the day offers a modest high, the clouds loom with a touch of melancholy, suggesting that a shift in the weather is all but inevitable. As evening approaches, the sky is likely to surrender to rain and patchy fog, cloaking the streets in a damp, mysterious veil.

In light of these prevailing conditions, dressing in layers would be prudent; a light coat accompanied by a scarf will provide comfort against the brisk breeze. As the chance of rain ramps up dramatically, cozying up indoors might be the most appealing choice, perhaps with a warm drink in hand while enjoying a good book or settling into a movie that transports to brighter realms. A gentle walk in the park could still be a beautiful indulgence for the adventurous, although it might be wise to carry an umbrella as a precaution against the increasing likelihood of downpours set to arrive before nightfall.
